name: PriceCharting API
tagline: Video game, console, and TCG market prices with graded variants.
description: Public market-price API for video games, consoles, and trading cards from PriceCharting. Returns ungraded and graded prices, product metadata, and historical trends for inventory, valuation, and collecting tools.

auth.details: API key via t parameter on query string; obtained with a paid PriceCharting subscription.

pricing.paid_plans: Subscription required; exact tiers not fully confirmed from public pages.

use_cases: look up current loose/CIB/new price for a video game
get graded card or game prices by product id
search products by name for inventory valuation
pull console and TCG market prices into a collection tracker
